subject: Q4 close: commit cleanse & payable cadence for bookings recognition
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 close: commit cleanse & payable cadence for bookings recognition

Hi team —

We need to run a short commit cleanse for HW-2028-0417 to make sure bookings will be eligible for recognition in the Nov close. Highwater has signaled they’ll submit PO next week but procurement wants clear invoice windows and a single ledger footprint. Action items below: 

- Ben: confirm whether we can accept a PO dated 11/28 and invoice on 11/29 for recognition in Nov.
- Vanessa: run the commit_matrix and mark any deals that require deferred invoicing due to milestone timing.
- Jonas: scope any ledger/recognition flags we need to set on the contract side (billing code, revenue hold reason).

I attached an initial commit_cleanse_matrix_v1.xlsx — please update the 'action' column before EOD tomorrow. I will follow up with procurement language to share with Highwater.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: commit_cleanse_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with deal rows, PO windows, recommended invoice dates)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 close: commit cleanse & payable cadence for bookings recognition

Lauren —

Quick read-through of the matrix. For HW-2028-0417 (Highwater Analytics):
- We can accept a PO dated through 11/28 and recognize in Nov if the invoice date is between 11/29–11/30 and services delivery is satisfied in November.
- If PO arrives >11/28, we have to push to Dec recognition unless we backdate invoice (not recommended without legal signoff).

I noted a risk on row 12 where markup terms differ (prepaid vs. net30). Vanessa and Jonas: that row needs a flag for "billing cadence mismatch" so we can advise procurement.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Renewals & Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 close: commit cleanse & payable cadence for bookings recognition

Thanks — updated the matrix and added notes on the two Highwater line items. Summary of changes: 

- Row 7 (pilot + MRR): flagged as two-part recognition (pilot recognized on delivery; MRR recognized on first invoice period). Recommend invoicing pilot on 11/29 and MRR starting 12/01 but include a one-time credit to align ARR reporting — see comments.
- Row 12 (enterprise bundle): vendor PO template requires net30; client insists on prepaid. Flags added: 'procurement negotiation' and 'defer recognition if PO not aligned'.

I also added a suggested PO template (HW_PO_template.pdf) in case procurement asks for standard language. Ben: if we can accept the 11/29 invoice for the pilot piece, I can confirm everything else is gated to the Dec slip.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: commit_cleanse_matrix_v1.xlsx (updated), HW_PO_template.pdf

From: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@acme-corp.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 close: commit cleanse & payable cadence for bookings recognition

Lauren —

Thanks for the clarity and for the template. Procurement at Highwater confirmed they will try to push the PO to 11/28; if it slips we will call out items that must be deferred to Dec. For the pilot piece we will approve a one-time invoice dated 11/29 and mark the MRR to start 12/01.

Next steps on our side: procurement will upload the signed PO into our contract portal by Monday; I will confirm with you as soon as it’s in. If anything changes we will escalate to Mark Dwyer (our finance lead).

Best,
Sandra Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager
Highwater Analytics
sandra.lopez@highwateranalytics.com
